literal: On jisi day dispatched envoys to congratulate completion of the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On jisi day envoys were sent to congratulate the completion of the Central Capital.

literal: On gengwu day performed sacrifice at the Zu and Huai mausoleums.
idiomatic: On gengwu day the court offered sacrifice at the Zu and Huai mausoleums.

literal: On xinwei day imperial halt at Huaizhou.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the court encamped at Huaizhou.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, augmented posthumous titles of Taizu, Taizong, Emperor Who Yielded the Realm, and Shizong; also posthumously titled Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu Emperor Qinshun.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the posthumous titles of Emperor Taizu, Emperor Taizong, the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm, and Emperor Shizong were augmented; Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu was also posthumously titled Emperor Qinshun.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuzi new moon, favorably visited the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On the wuzi new moon of the tenth winter month the court visited the Central Capital.

literal: Twelfth month, Xiao Tuyu memorialized campaigning against Ganzhou Uighurs, reduced their king Yelali, pacified and returned.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xiao Tuyu reported a campaign against the Ganzhou Uighurs, subdued their king Yelali, reassured the people, and returned.

literal: That year, jinshi Shi Kezhong and thirteen others were passed and granted degree.
idiomatic: That year Shi Kezhong and twelve others passed the examinations.

literal: Twenty-seventh year, spring, first month, hooked fish on the Tu River.
idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, in the first spring month, the court went ice fishing on the Tu River.

literal: Hunted at Ruilu Plain.
idiomatic: The court hunted at Ruilu Plain.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingxu new moon, imperial halt at the Central Capital, constructing palace halls.
idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the fourth summer month the court encamped at the Central Capital and began building palace halls.

literal: On gengxu day abolished Bazhou disposition office.
idiomatic: On gengxu day the Bazhou disposition office was abolished.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiayin new moon, continuous rain; Huang, Tu, Wala, and Yinliang four rivers all overflowed, washing away commoners' dwellings.
idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon of the seventh autumn month heavy rains caused the Huang, Tu, Wala, and Yinliang rivers to overflow and wash away civilian dwellings.

literal: Eighth month, on jiashen day, northern tour.
idiomatic: On jiashen day of the eighth month the court made a northern tour.

literal: Winter, eleventh month, on renzi new moon, performed firewood-and-script rite.
idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the eleventh winter month the firewood-and-script rites were performed.

literal: Twelfth month, on yiyou day, southern tour.
idiomatic: On yiyou day of the twelfth month the court made a southern tour.

literal: The Empress Dowager was unwell.
idiomatic: The Empress Dowager fell ill.

literal: On wuzi day proclaimed general amnesty.
idiomatic: On wuzi day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: On xinmao day the Empress Dowager died at the traveling palace.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the Empress Dowager died at the traveling palace.

literal: On renchen day dispatched envoys to report mourning to Song, Xia, and Goryeo.
idiomatic: On renchen day envoys were sent to announce the mourning to Song, Western Xia, and Goryeo.

literal: On wushen day went to the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On wushen day the court went to the Central Capital.

literal: On jiyou day an edict canceled congratulations for the Thousand Age Festival.
idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict canceled observance of the Thousand Age Festival.

literal: That year, imperial preliminary examination of Liu Eryi and three others.
idiomatic: That year Liu Eryi and two others passed the imperial preliminary examination.
